messages.text: Finally had a chance to plug in my nerdQoctaxe++ - and it does not work.  The fans try to spin but only move about 3 cm then stop.  It’s not working…..

I've sent this chat to our technical specialist, and he'll reply to your message here. I haven't written to you myself, so that he answers your question directly.

The unit is the NerdOctaxe from order Shop····, which arrived September 15. On first power-on the fans twitch about 3 cm and then stop. That's the problem he'll work on with you.

If he can't get it running, the next step is a warranty return. I haven't promised you a return or a replacement yet, because both depend on what he finds.
